|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2022-01-15.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates given below are the documented PC image-repository revision dates (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2022-01-15-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2021-06-23.gif]], 23 June 2021) → [[File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2022-01-15-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-captainherasyndulla_ai-2022-01-15.gif]], 15 January 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image repository revision dated 19 February 2021<ref name="img-Light3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Kirdo III Operative”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. If with an Imperial (or two Rebels), adds one battle destiny. During battle, if you just drew a destiny < number of Rebels here, may cancel and redraw that destiny.”
